verdicts.rewritten_summary: Official gazette text (BOE-A-2023-5366) of State Law 4/2023 of 28 February 2023, the law for the real and effective equality of trans people and the guarantee of LGBTI rights. Title II regulates rectification of the registered sex entry by the person's freely expressed will, depathologizes the procedure (no medical diagnosis or treatment requirement) and removes the former age-majority requirement for requesting it, with corresponding document adaptation; Title III provides protection and reparation against LGBTIphobic discrimination and violence. The law mandates measures across administrative, workplace, health and education fields, with public authorities acting within their competences; the education-facing and administrative provisions are implemented by the autonomous communities, this region's government among them.

verdicts.rewritten_summary: Human Rights Watch, 16 February 2023, reporting the Spanish Congress of Deputies' passage of the comprehensive LGBTI law known as the 'Trans Law': legal gender recognition by self-identification through a simple administrative process, replacing the prior requirements of a gender-dysphoria diagnosis and two years of medical treatment aligned to the sought marker. The law strengthens sexuality education, bans medically unnecessary normalising surgery on intersex children before their consent, enables parental recognition for unmarried same-sex couples and prohibits LGBTI discrimination in healthcare, employment and housing; children from age 12 may obtain recognition under certain conditions, a provision that provoked political conflict. HRW assesses the reform as upholding European and international standards against abusive, disproportionate requirements for legal gender recognition.
verdicts.note: rule-5 keep: record claims the 2023 registry reform (self-declaration from age 12 without medical diagnosis) drew an international rights organisation's autonomy-first ranking of the country; HRW report supports that claim; no region-specific source covers it
